title: C-7 tie spacing matches latest value but user cites superseded R1

turns.user: C-7 column level 3 mein tie spacing 100 mm hai, SSB-STR-L3-201 rev one ke hisaab se
samjha, latest R2 hai. observation log kar do, RFI nahi chahiye

notes: R1 is superseded. R2, issued through RFI-SSB-006, requires 100 mm ties at C-7 and C-8.

title: C-8 tie spacing 140 exceeds the R2 tolerance

turns.user: C-8 column level 3 mein tie spacing 140 mm measure hua, STR 201 R2
haan 140 pakka hai, NCR raise karo aur rectification karao

notes: R2 requires 100 mm with a 10 mm tolerance; 140 mm is outside tolerance.

title: Repeated grid C-7 requires a level before a clean observation

turns.user: C-7 column ke ties 150 mm hain
ICU floor, level 4 wala C-7, drawing STR 202 R0. haan 150 confirm, log kar do

notes: C-7 exists on both L3 and L4. The first turn must not be silently assigned to either level.

title: Lift-core hot work without fire watch blocks work

turns.user: Zone C level 4 lift core mein welding chal rahi hai, hot work okay log kar do
fire watcher nahi hai? theek hai welding band karo, stop work

notes: HWP-2031 is active but its mandatory fire-watch checks are unsatisfied.

title: Suspended sump excavation permit prevents restart

turns.user: sump ki excavation restart karo, machine ready hai
EXC-2017 suspended hai toh kaam mat chalu karo, stop work

notes: EXC-2017 is suspended after groundwater ingress and side slumping; shoring and dewatering are pending.

title: OT slab built to superseded 150 mm detail instead of latest 200 mm

turns.user: level 3 OT slab thickness 150 mm check hui, SSB STR L3 211 rev zero ke according
latest R1 mein 200 hai? NCR raise karo, pour se pehle correct karna hai

notes: RFI-SSB-008 revised the OT slab from 150 mm at R0 to 200 mm at R1.

title: L3 OT slab pour cannot start while pre-pour hold point is open

turns.user: level 3 OT slab ka concrete pour start karte hain, RMC truck aa gaya
hold point release nahi hua toh pour hold karo, stop work

notes: CL-PP-SSB-L3-001 is on HOLD with cover, staging certification, sleeve RFI and PMC release outstanding.

title: Unknown structural drawing is corrected before logging

turns.user: C-9 column level 3 cover 40 mm hai, drawing SSB-STR-L3-209 R0
sorry drawing STR 201 rev 2 hai, cover 40 confirm, log kar do

notes: SSB-STR-L3-209 does not exist. The corrected latest drawing is SSB-STR-L3-201 R2.
